visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and a white T-shirt faces the camera in a dimly lit bedroom setting. He holds a white, square makeup compact with a reflective surface. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically while yellow variety-show style text appears at the top. (2) He opens the compact to reveal a mirror and beige pressed powder. The man brings the product closer to the lens for detail. He touches the powder with a white sponge, demonstrating the texture while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (3) The man looks into a handheld mirror and applies the powder foundation to his left cheek and forehead. The lighting is warm, highlighting the skin's texture before and after application. Yellow subtitles and variety captions pulse at the bottom. (4) A graphic overlay appears showing a layout of six different skin tone shades of the powder, along with a price tag of NT$3,850. The background man continues to talk and gesture towards his face, highlighting the finish. (5) The man gives a final recommendation, holding the closed white compact near his face. He smiles, nods, and uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. The setting remains constant with the warm lamp and white bedding behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male speech begins immediately with a friendly, energetic tone. Background music is a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming in a major key at approximately 108 BPM. Spectral balance is bright with clear phoneme articulation. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs as the compact case is handled, followed by continued rapid speech describing the product. The music maintains a constant volume bed underneath the vocals. (3) Subtle rustling sounds are audible during the application phase, blending with the rhythmic guitar. The vocal tone becomes more intimate and persuasive. (4) A clear 'Ding' SFX triggers during the display of product shades and pricing info. The music and speech continue simultaneously without interruption. (5) Closing remarks delivered with a rising intonation, emphasizing recommendation. The guitar track ends with a clean fade-out at the very end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Product Intro -> Demonstration -> Evidence (Skin Close-up) -> Pricing -> CTA/Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional beauty endorsement and tutorial for Clé de Peau Beauté's powder foundation. By combining high-energy narration, visual evidence of skin transformation, and pricing transparency, it aims to persuade the audience of the product's value and effectiveness for summer use.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand '肌膚之鑰' (Clé de Peau Beauté), demonstration of the product, and inclusion of pricing and shade information.
